description: Returns one file of a spec as text. Use it for a file pull_spec listed without content, unless its note says to download it. A long file comes in parts: when the answer has nextLine, call again with that line. Give version to read the file as a kept earlier version has it.

line.description: The first line to return. Leave it out to start at the top.

path.description: The file's path, as pull_spec and get_spec list it.

version.description: The version to read the file from, like 1.4.0. Leave it out for the newest.

name: get_spec_file
title: Read one spec file
